conventions.monorepo: server/ is the Node backend; public/ is the browser client it serves; 'wms flutter application/' is the Flutter mobile client

deployment.note: Hostinger VPS under Docker Compose at /opt/apps/wms since 2026-09-06, with a SQLite database bind-mounted at /opt/apps/wms/data/wms.db. The Passenger shared-hosting layout this field described until 2026-09-14 no longer exists; commands written against it would fail or act on the wrong path. Production safety invariants are defined in CLAUDE.md and docs/WMS-PRODUCTION-RUNBOOK.md and are authoritative over this note.
